4:60.text: Have you not seen those who claim to have believed in what was revealed to you,
, and what was revealed before you? They wish to refer legislation to ṭāghūt,
while they were commanded to reject it; and Satan wishes to lead them far astray.

4:61.text: And when it is said to them, "Come to what Allāh has revealed and to the Messenger," you see the hypocrites turning away from you in aversion.
